refactoring_patterns.overview: Common patterns used when refactoring for SRP compliance.

pattern.name: repository_extraction
pattern.description: Extract data access logic from a service class into a dedicated Repository class.

pattern.name: strategy_extraction
pattern.description: Extract algorithm/strategy logic into pluggable Strategy classes.
pattern.before: def process(self, data): # Strategy A result_a = self._algorithm_a(data) if not result_a: # Strategy B result_a = self._algorithm_b(data) return result_a

pattern.name: feedback_processor_extraction
pattern.description: Extract feedback/template processing logic into a dedicated processor.
